effect.name: Heat Haze
effect.description: Soft rising noise that bends the image, the air over a fire or a desert floor. Unlike Wave this has no repeating pattern, so it holds up over a whole screen.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Strength
parameter.description: How far pixels move, in texels.

parameter.name: Cell Size
parameter.description: Size of one noise cell in texels. Small is a fine shimmer, large is slow rolling air.

parameter.name: Rise Speed
parameter.description: How fast the haze climbs when Time is animated.

parameter.name: Time
parameter.description: Animate this or the haze stands still.

parameter.name: Vertical Bias
parameter.description: 0 wobbles evenly in both directions, 1 mostly pushes pixels up and down like rising air.
